case_number: 2025 INSC 275; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. OF 2025 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (C) NO. 18717 OF 2022)
summary: Property contribution to partnership firm under Section 14, Indian Partnership Act, 1932; relinquishment deed effect; property becomes firm's asset upon contribution for business; Transfer of Property Act modes inapplicable; High Court clarification upheld; legal heirs' claim rejected; inheritance limited to partnership share, not underlying property.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court's clarification upheld; firm declared owner-in-possession; appellant's claim rejected.
